title: US govt proposes scrapping 60-day grace period for foreign workers after job loss

This proposal is based on the belief that the grace period compromises the integrity of employment-related visa classifications. A decision to remove this grace period would introduce significant financial and logistical hurdles for those impacted.

title: Missile with ‘eyes’: Iran’s new missile can hunt targets without GPS, putting US warships on alert

title: 1980s AI Photo trend: 5 ChatGPT prompts to create Kerala-style retro images

title: Algeria cuts diplomatic ties with UAE over 'provocative, hostile' actions
content: In a notable diplomatic shift, Algeria has officially severed ties with the United Arab Emirates, following a period of escalating tensions. The nations disagree on key regional matters, particularly concerning Western Sahara and the Sahel, with Algeria accusing the UAE of hostile provocations. This rift also underscores contrasting positions on Israel and Middle Eastern relations, marking a crucial break in bilateral relations between the two countries.

title: US built taller smokestacks to cut local pollution; acid rain spread farther
content: In an effort to mitigate local air pollution, American power companies constructed towering smokestacks, effectively releasing sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides into higher winds. Unfortunately, this practice contributed to acid rain, harming ecosystems throughout North America. In response, Congress revised the Clean Air Act to restrict the use of tall stacks and improve emission control by emphasizing source capture instead.

title: Why iPhones are so expensive in India again

title: Scientists warmed Minnesota trees by 3.4°C; they adapted to most of the heat
content: the open-air study was designed to mimic future warming while maintaining natural outdoor conditions . researchers established plots in both open and closed-canopy forest environments and planted seedlings representing 11 tree species . the study challenged a key assumption about how trees respond to climate change .

title: Philadelphia gave 340 seniors white roofs; homes cooled by 5°F, saving 560 kWh
